About this project

gridmon is a Stage 1 research prototype: an offline monitor that detects and classifies grid events in triggered three-phase voltage records at a battery inverter, and an honest comparison of transparent rules with a small learned model.

Simulated, assumed, validated

Evidence levels used throughout the project
tagmeaningexamples here
[SIM]result of this project's simulationsevery accuracy number, the C-core equivalence, the port-layer stream test
[STD]standard or regulatory document0.90 / 1.10 pu dip and swell thresholds (IEC 61000-4-30 practice, IEEE 1159 categories)
[LIT]literature or incident reportBollen dip types, DSOGI-PLL, the 2016 Blue Cut Fire phase-jump misreading
[ASSUMED]illustrative engineering assumptionstrong grid, 3-wire LL sensing, 1 s records with 0.2–0.4 s onset, trigger thresholds, frequency recovery profile
[EXP]experimentally validatednone — nothing has been run on hardware or measured data

The C2000 code compiles with TI's compiler (validation level L2), but it has not run on a microcontroller yet (L3). See the validation ladder.

How to reproduce

git clone https://github.com/shikhar-s-7/gridmon
cd gridmon
python3.12 -m venv .venv            # Windows: py -3.12 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
.venv/bin/python -m pip install -e .
.venv/bin/python scripts/run_all.py --fast   # data, rules, golden vectors, GBM, sealed evaluation (fast subset)
.venv/bin/python -m pytest
.venv/bin/python scripts/build_c.py          # C core for the PC
.venv/bin/python scripts/run_sil.py --fast   # C core vs Python
.venv/bin/python scripts/build_site.py       # this website (web/dist)
python -m http.server -d web/dist 8000       # preview at http://localhost:8000

All random numbers come from seeded generators; every report records the git commit and configuration hash. This site was built from commit e9cc0e2; its numbers are read from the committed reports at build time.

Privacy

This site is static. It sets no cookies, has no analytics or tracking and makes no requests to other servers. The theme choice is kept in your browser's local storage. Uploaded CSV files never leave your browser.
